description: The Vogue Paris cover from a given date: a birthday, an anniversary, a month in history. A full date or a month returns the issue on or nearest that date (within two months). A month and day with no year ("06-15") returns the issue nearest that day in every year the archive holds. Covers come back as images for 1930 and earlier; later issues get their date and reader link. Example questions: "Vogue cover from the day my grandmother was born, 1927-04-02"; "what was on Vogue in March 1925"; "Vogue covers on my birthday, 15 June".

date.description: "1927-04-02", "1925-03", or "06-15" for that day in every year

name: vogue_cover_on_date
title: Vogue cover on a date
